tools.name: departments_list
tools.description: List departments for a company (each department contains its open jobs). Required: board_token. Optional: render_as (default: list). Returns array of Department.

tools.name: jobs_get
tools.description: Retrieve a single job posting. Required: board_token, job_id. Optional: questions (default: false). Returns the JobDetail.

params.name: job_id
params.description: Greenhouse job id (from the `id` field in the list endpoint)

params.name: questions
params.description: Include application questions, location questions, compliance, and demographic questions

tools.name: jobs_list
tools.description: List all open jobs for a company. Required: board_token. Optional: content (default: false). Returns array of Job.

params.name: content
params.description: Set true to include full description, departments, and offices for each job

tools.name: offices_list
tools.description: List offices for a company (each office contains its departments and their jobs). Required: board_token. Optional: render_as (default: list). Returns array of Office.
